release_name: Live TV v3.9.2 — Real-Time Match Scores, Overs, Goals & Bangladesh Standard Time (BST)
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🕒 Bangladesh Standard Time (BST, UTC+6): All match start times and dates are now precisely converted and displayed in Bangladesh Standard Time (e.g. 'Today, 8:35 AM BST', 'Oct 31, 12:45 PM BST')
🏏 Live Cricket Scores, Overs & Wickets: Cards now display real-time live match scores with wickets and overs (e.g. 'IND: 24/3 (2.1/6 ov)', 'SOA: 154 & 262/5 (81 ov, target 422)')
📢 Match Situation & Summaries: Real-time summaries like 'South Aust require 160 runs', 'NSW trail by 414 runs', or 'U.A.E. won toss & fielded' are highlighted on match cards
⚽ Football Goal Scores & Live Clocks: Shows live scoreline (e.g. 'Home 2 - 1 Away • 90'+5'') for world football fixtures
🔗 Seamless Stream & Telemetry Fusion: Merges live HD match broadcast streams with real-time ESPN telemetry, retaining instant '▶ Watch Live' access
🛡️ Retains all v3.9.1 features: Continuous SPOTV 2 HD playback without WebKit CDM crashes, Phone Remote, Drag-to-resize PiP, and 2,989 channels
